method: Actual encoded-master contact sheet, ten scene midpoint overview, fourteen-frame progression sheet and six enlarged decoded frames inspected visually.
findings: Opening names and roles are legible and unclipped.
Route gives way to the blank register; binding and the original early newspaper report enter with their explanation.
Ownership demand is distinguished from appearance and labeled as later participant testimony.
Release progresses from prior travel confirmation to illness-based discretion without invented dialogue or countdown.
Philadelphia arrival is separated from Boston recapture danger and England departure; corrected route arrow has no filled triangle.
Final named portraits restore both people and emphasize their strategy and agency.
Captions remain on a stable dark field, with archival objects and changing explanatory visuals above.
limitations: Sampled visual inspection is not all-frame geometry proof or continuous human playback.
ASR and signal checks do not substitute for owner listening to pronunciation, prosody and semantic caption timing.
No mobile/native platform UI or crop evidence.
